scripts.build: test -z $TURBO_HASH && turbo run build || echo OK
scripts.types: script_path="$(pnpm root -w)/../scripts/pkg-types.sh"; if [ -f "$script_path" ]; then "$script_path"; else tsc --build; fi
scripts.types:watch: script_path="$(pnpm root -w)/../scripts/pkg-types.sh"; if [ -f "$script_path" ]; then "$script_path" watch; else tsc --build --watch; fi
